---
name: Bug report
about: Something converted wrong or crashed
---

**What did you convert?**
Link to the cursor pack (or attach the .zip / .ani file).

**What did you run?**
Exact command, e.g. `python3 cursor_converter.py "pack.zip" --theme X --out /tmp/x`

**What happened?**
Error message or what looks wrong (wrong colors, missing busy cursor, etc.)

**System:** distro + desktop (e.g. Ubuntu 24.04 / GNOME), `python3 --version`, Pillow version.
